title: Treaty of Trianon
summary: Wikidata item Q181902, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1920 peace agreement formally ending World War I between most of the Allies of World War I and the Kingdom of Hungary". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
